'''Ak-rev''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] drum master and a bodyguard for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. He was born in the [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital city]] of [[Al-Campur]]. While on Sriluur, he studied at the Weequay monastery to their [[God/Legends|god]] of thunder, [[Am-Shak/Legends|Am-Shak]]. While he was outside the monastery, Ak-rev often fought in the streets of Al-Campur. While on a trip to the desert world of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Ak-rev was hired as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], after the Hutt witnessed a fight between Ak and one of Jabba's [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guards. While in Jabba's employ, Ak would play a large set of drums to back up the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]] along with a [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]], [[Umpass-stay/Legends|Umpass-stay]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], he witnessed the death of one of Jabba's [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] dancers, the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Oola/Legends|Oola]], for insubordination. After the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|death]] of Jabba at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]] at the hands of the [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], Ak and Umpass set out across the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] to [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. While making their way across the dunes, the pair was attacked by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]], and Ak was beaten to [[Death/Legends|death]] by the Sand People.

==Biography==
Ak-rev was a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="DB" /> [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] into the streets of [[Al-Campur]], the capital [[City/Legends|city]] of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]]. At some point during his [[Youngling/Legends|childhood]], he was orphaned and taken into a [[Monastery/Legends|monastery]] dedicated to [[Am-Shak/Legends|Am-Shak]], the Weequay [[God/Legends|god]] of thunder. Ak-rev lived at the monastery, was watched and tutored by monks, and developed a love for the temple [[Drum/Legends|drums]], which played a vital role in the religious practices for Am-Shak. Whenever the Weequay could escape the monks, Ak-rev spent time out on the streets of Al-Campur, skirmishing with the street gangs, learning how to fight, and becoming a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] sparring adept. He eventually caught the attention of one of the monastery's [[Unidentified Am-Shak monastery senior brother|senior brothers]], who took the role of training Ak-rev in hand-to-hand combat. The brother's intention was for the Weequay to use legitimate fighting and boxing to channel his aggression into productive channels, and the goal was achieved, though only while Ak-rev was young enough to be at the monastery.<ref name="Sourcebook" />

Ak-Rev did not trust outlanders and non-Weequays, and while on a visit to Tatooine, Ak had a brawl with [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]]. The Gamorreans were in the employment of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]], more commonly know as Jabba the Hutt. Jabba was impressed by Ak-Rev's tenacity, and agreed to hire him as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]]. While the Hutt disgusted Ak-Rev, he agreed, if only because there were so many Weequays in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] that he felt at home again. When Jabba the Hutt heard Ak-rev's passionate drum performance at an Am-Shak ceremony, he offered Ak-rev a position in the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]] alongside the [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Umpass-stay/Legends|Umpass-stay]]. They would occasionally play backup for the band on huge drums.

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Ak and Umpass, along with the rest of the Max Rebo Band, were playing a [[Jedi Rocks/Legends|song]] to entertain Jabba's quests, when they witnessed the death of one of Jabba's [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] dancers, [[Oola/Legends|Oola]]. Oola had refused the Hutt crime lord's advances, and as a result, the Twi'lek was dropped into a large pit underneath [[Jabba's Palace/Legends#Throne room|Jabba's throne room]] that housed his pet [[Rancor/Legends|Rancor]] midway through the song. Oola was subsequently eaten alive by the large predator.

Later that night, Jabba captured the [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] hero [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], who had been disguised as the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]], while she was trying to rescue [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and as a result, Leia was put into slavery under the Hutt. Solo was an ex-[[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] turned rebellion [[General/Legends|General]] who was frozen in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] a year earlier for failing to repay Jabba for dumping a large amount of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] while on a run for the Hutt. The next day, the last [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and rebel [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] came to Jabba's palace to negotiate the release of Han, Leia, and Solo's [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] companion, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], who had been brought into Jabba's custody by Leia when she was disguised as Boushh so she could get into the palace, but Skywalker too was captured.

Ak and Umpass stayed behind at Jabba's palace when the Hutt and several of his denizens went out into the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] in [[Khetanna/Legends|his sail barge]] to [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|execute]] Han, Luke, and Chewbacca at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]]. However, Jabba's prisoners freed themselves with the help of [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], who had been disguised as one of Jabba's guards. The Hutt was killed when Leia choked him with chain he had used to keep the princess imprisoned.

When news of Jabba's death reached Ak-rev and Umpass-stay, the two set out across the Dune Sea, through [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] territory, bound for Mos Eisley, a small [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] town. En route, they were ambushed by a tribe of Sand People whose [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]] had been slain by Ak's fellow Weequays in a sacrifice to the Weequays' gods. The Raiders beat Ak-rev to death, returning the favor of sacrifice, although Umpass survived and lived on to serve another [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic clan]] house.

==Behind the scenes==
Ak-rev was added to the extended musical number in the [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|Special Edition]] of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']]. The drumming done by him and [[Umpass-stay]] was derived from the Japanese art of Taiko drumming with the help of San Francisco Taiko Dojo.

Hasbro released an Ak-rev figure in [[2008]] including a leg of [[R7-Z0]].
